categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds ci/test/wrap-fd-limit.sh and updates macOS CI scripts (ci/test/00_setup_env_mac_native.sh, ci/test/03_test_script.sh) to simulate low-FD environments in PR CI.
categories.rationale: Prevents recurring file descriptor regressions on platforms constrained by FD_SETSIZE by adding test FD limits to per-PR CI. The author notes that NetBSD regressions recurred in PR #31537, PR #36078, and PR #35037 because NetBSD only runs in nightly CI.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labled Tests and changes test/functional/test_framework/test_node.py and util.py to adjust node maxconnections under -ipcbind.
categories.rationale: Fixes broken test framework execution for IPC tests on NetBSD platforms. As noted in commit 62571e7e67, 'the framework's -maxconnections=76 no longer fits the 256 file descriptor budget on NetBSD, and every interface_ipc*.py node starts with 'Warning: Reducing -maxconnections ...', which the framework treats as a failure.'
